description: Fetches one vertodigital.com page in full as clean markdown, without navigation or footer. Not a search: take the slug from vertodigital_search_site, or guess it, since an unknown slug returns an isError result with a hint. slug "contact" returns the contact page followed by a "Contact details" list: name and role, email, LinkedIn, reply time and form URL. Fetched live and returned whole, most pages under 20 KB, no pagination.

slug.description: Path such as "about" or "case-studies/ironscales". Case, a trailing slash and .md or .html are ignored; a full URL works; empty returns the homepage.

name: vertodigital_get_page
